name: ESOP / joining bonus mentioned but candidate never probed terms
notes: Phase 2.3: comp_breakup_probe_missing fires when benefits come up and candidate accepts blind.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a senior PM with 8 years across Cred and Zerodha. Built fraud detection workflows at Cred for the past 3 years.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into wealth-tech where I can apply the fraud learnings to a different risk surface.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 90 days, buyout possible at 1.5 months gross, handover plan documented. Earliest LWD is end of next quarter.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: On comp — we offer base + variable + a joining bonus, plus an ESOP grant with the standard vesting cliff. There's also a clawback if you leave before 18 months. Are you okay with that structure?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yeah that sounds fine, I'm okay with the structure.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your founder's recent talk at YC Fintech on KYC unification is exactly the bet I want to be on. The product surface lines up with my fraud-detection background.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What questions do you have for us?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: How is the wealth-tech team structured? What does success look like in the first 90 days?
